content.value_statement: Slow Spark jobs waste cluster time and hide scaling problems. This skill guides partitioning, caching, shuffle, and memory tuning for PySpark pipelines.
actual_capabilities: Explains Spark execution stages, shuffles, partitions, memory pressure, and data skew.
Provides PySpark configuration patterns for AQE, Kryo serialization, shuffle compression, and executor memory.
Shows join optimization options, including broadcast joins, bucket joins, and salting for skewed keys.
Covers caching, persistence, checkpointing, and when to release cached DataFrames.
Includes monitoring checks for query plans, active stages, executor memory, and partition skew.
Summarizes storage choices such as Parquet, Delta, predicate pushdown, and Z-ordering.
limitations: Does not execute Spark jobs or read Spark UI metrics by itself.
Examples use placeholder storage paths and must be adapted before use.
Recommendations need workload size, data distribution, and cluster details for accuracy.
Does not replace benchmarking on production-like data.

use_cases.title: Reduce Batch Pipeline Runtime
use_cases.description: Review a slow ETL job and identify partition, shuffle, caching, and file format improvements.

use_cases.title: Tune Cluster Resource Use
use_cases.description: Plan executor memory, cores, shuffle partitions, and AQE settings for a growing Spark workload.

use_cases.title: Diagnose Data Skew
use_cases.description: Use Spark metrics and partition checks to find skew and choose salting or broadcast strategies.

prompt_templates.title: Find Basic Bottlenecks
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner review of a slow Spark job
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my slow Spark job. Explain likely bottlenecks and give basic partition, cache, and shuffle checks I can apply safely.

prompt_templates.title: Reduce Shuffles
prompt_templates.prompt: Tune this PySpark transformation for fewer shuffles. Consider broadcast joins, salting, predicate pushdown, and partition sizing.

prompt_templates.title: Create Tuning Checklist
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a Spark performance checklist for this pipeline. Include executor memory, AQE, file format, caching, skew detection, and validation steps.

prompt_templates.title: Plan Production Optimization
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze this production Spark workload. Recommend a tuning plan across joins, storage layout, Delta optimization, monitoring metrics, and rollback checks.

output_examples.input: A daily PySpark aggregation became slow after the input volume doubled.
output: Likely bottlenecks include shuffle growth, under-sized partitions, and possible data skew.
Recommended checks include Spark UI shuffle size, spilled bytes, partition counts, and stage duration variance.
Suggested actions include AQE, partition pruning, pre-aggregation, and validation against the prior output.

output_examples.input: A join between a large fact table and a small dimension table is timing out.
output: The skill would compare broadcast join, sort-merge join, and bucket join options.
It would check dimension size, executor memory, skewed keys, and shuffle metrics before recommending a strategy.

output_examples.input: A team needs a reusable Spark tuning checklist for release reviews.
output: The result would cover partition sizing, caching rules, memory settings, file format choices, and monitoring metrics.
It would include validation steps for runtime, shuffle volume, spills, and result correctness.

best_practices: Start with Spark UI evidence before changing configuration values.
Change one tuning variable at a time and compare runtime, spills, and shuffle size.
Validate output correctness after repartitioning, caching, or changing join strategy.
anti_patterns: Using collect or count on large data for quick checks.
Broadcasting tables without checking size and executor memory.
Adding cache calls without reuse or cleanup.

faq.question: Can this skill tune Databricks jobs?
faq.answer: Yes. The guidance covers Spark patterns that apply to Databricks, including Delta optimization topics.

faq.question: Does it run benchmarks automatically?
faq.answer: No. It provides tuning guidance and verification steps, but users must run jobs and collect metrics.

faq.question: What inputs improve the recommendations?
faq.answer: Provide job code, data sizes, partition counts, cluster settings, Spark UI metrics, and known failures.

faq.question: Can it help with data skew?
faq.answer: Yes. It explains skew detection, AQE skew handling, salting, and broadcast join alternatives.

faq.question: Is it only for PySpark?
faq.answer: Most examples use PySpark, but the tuning concepts also apply to Scala Spark and Spark SQL.

faq.question: Does it change production data?
faq.answer: No. The skill is advisory. Users choose whether to apply any recommended code or configuration changes.
